name: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach Providers
description: Adult-only Scarlet Peach stream providers for Nuvio. Hanime, HentaiHaven, and HStream are production providers sharing the Scarlet Peach schema v2 metadata core and external identity bridge. Provider-specific playback transport remains isolated so one source cannot destabilize the others.

scrapers.name: Hanime
scrapers.description: Hanime provider for Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata, TMDB numeric IDs, IMDb IDs, and compatible legacy HentaiStream title slugs. Exact schema v2 Hanime episode mappings bypass catalog search and go directly to the signed AES-GCM handshake. Optional account settings authenticate directly from Nuvio to Hanime and pass only the temporary session token to the resolver for premium qualities. Stream labels follow the Nexus quality/audio standard and include verified censorship metadata when available.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from Yuzono AniYomi Hanime and anime-src/hanime-stremio

scrapers.name: HentaiHaven
scrapers.description: Production HentaiHaven provider. Uses hentaihaven.com first and hentaihaven.vip as a working mirror fallback with Romanization-aware matching and secure player token decoding. HLS qualities use a minimal quality-scoped master containing the selected video rendition and separate audio group only. HentaiHaven WebVTT subtitles are exposed independently through the Scarlet Peach catalog addon's subtitles resource so subtitle handling cannot disturb video/audio playback.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol references from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin and ngomile/anigrab HentaiHaven extractors

scrapers.name: HStream
scrapers.description: Production HStream provider using Scarlet Peach MAL/AniList/SP metadata plus the shared TMDB/IMDb ingress bridge. Resolves HStream episode pages through direct slug and search fallback, performs the XSRF-protected player API handshake, follows multiple CDN domains, and returns native DASH/MPD streams. Android receives the clean MPD plus external ASS subtitles; desktop receives the native WebVTT-injected DASH wrapper. Client testing has validated 720p, 1080p, 2160p/4K and subtitles on supported titles.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus: Scarlet Peach; protocol reference from cynthia2006/hanime-plugin HStream extractor
